subject: Probably S18: cards/qbank 'load failure shows the error' e2e now show cached data instead of the mocked 503
body: Reproduced on shared web code without S22's web changes (webkit-ipad-portrait, --retries=0): cards.spec.ts:322 'a load failure shows the error with its request id and retries' and qbank.spec.ts:187 'a pool failure shows the error ...'. The test routes /api/cards/due (resp. the pool) to a 503 and reloads; the page renders the cached state ('No cards due' / the builder) instead of the error. Looks like the offline layer serves its cache on a server error, not only when offline. If that is intended (stale-while-error), the specs need updating and the page should still say it is showing saved data; if not, the fallback should apply only to network failures/offline. Also: TrustedHTML report-only lines are fixed at the source in e403e32 (the only HTML sinks were the two inert DOMParser parses; they now use a private policy), so watchers do not need to ignore them anymore.
